stem: In what way do both Patrick from "Prince Patrick" and Emily from "A Wintry Welcome" change throughout the stories?

options.label: F
options.text: They both are worried but then become relieved in the end.

options.label: G
options.text: They both feel doubtful about their abilities but then become confident.

options.label: H
options.text: They both are unhappy about their circumstances but then learn to accept them.

options.label: J
options.text: They both feel excited at first but then are displeased with events that occur.
